changes.to: No maker website or datasheet: Robot Wolf is a product of Jianshe Industry (China South Industries Group), reported by China Military Online, Xinhua and CCTV. Official military media give 15 km/h, 12 joint DoF, 25 kg carried, 30 cm obstacles, and state the units share perception data; these are state-media figures, not a maker specification, so no spec field is filled. First shown at Airshow China in November 2024 and paraded in September 2025.
Chinese military quadruped 'wolf' family shown as a swarming ground-combat system with reconnaissance, strike and support units.
